passages.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said, “Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf, since Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps the LORD will perform for us something like all His past wonders, so that Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from us.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
King Zedekiah sent messengers to Jeremiah.
Pashhur son of Malchijah was one messenger.
Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest was the other messenger.
The messengers brought a request to Jeremiah.
They said, “Please ask the LORD to help us.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
He is fighting against us.
Maybe the LORD will do miracles for us again.
Maybe the LORD will make Nebuchadnezzar leave us.”
passages.original: הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה בִּשְׁלֹ֨חַ אֵלָ֜יו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֶת־ פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּ֔ה וְאֶת־ צְפַנְיָ֧ה בֶן־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ דְּרָשׁ־ נָ֤א בַעֲדֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל נִלְחָ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ אוּלַי֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתָ֙נוּ֙ כְּכָל־ נִפְלְאֹתָ֔יו וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלֵֽינוּ׃ס

passages.text: But Jeremiah answered, “You are to tell Zedekiah that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will turn against you the weapons of war in your hands, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the wall, and I will assemble their forces in the center of this city.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of God.
Jeremiah spoke to the messengers from King Zedekiah.
Jeremiah said, “Tell this to Zedekiah.”
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD says this:
‘I will turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands.
You are using these weapons to fight the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans.
The Chaldeans are besieging you outside the city wall.
I will gather all these enemy forces.
I will bring them into the center of this city.’
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְרֻ֖ן אֶל־ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֣י מֵסֵב֮ אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיֶדְכֶם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם נִלְחָמִ֣ים בָּ֗ם אֶת־ מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְאֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַצָּרִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם מִח֖וּץ לַֽחוֹמָ֑ה וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury, and great wrath.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
The LORD says, “I Myself will fight against you.
I will use My outstretched hand.
I will use My mighty arm.
I will fight with anger.
I will fight with fury.
I will fight with great wrath.”
passages.original: וְנִלְחַמְתִּ֤י אֲנִי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם בְּיָ֥ד נְטוּיָ֖ה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ חֲזָקָ֑ה וּבְאַ֥ף וּבְחֵמָ֖ה וּבְקֶ֥צֶף גָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: I will strike down the residents of this city, both man and beast. They will die in a terrible plague.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will strike the people who live in this city.
The LORD will strike the animals in this city.
A terrible plague will kill the people.
A terrible plague will kill the animals.
passages.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֗י אֶת־ יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת־ הָאָדָ֖ם וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל יָמֻֽתוּ׃

passages.text: ‘After that,’ declares the LORD, ‘I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officers, and the people in this city who survive the plague and sword and famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will put them to the sword; he will not spare them or show pity or compassion.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks these words.
He says what will happen after these things.
Zedekiah is the king of Judah.
He has officers.
There are people in this city.
Some people survive the plague.
Some survive the sword.
Some survive the famine.
The LORD will hand over Zedekiah, his officers, and these survivors.
He will give them to Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
The LORD will also give them to their enemies.
These enemies want to take their lives.
Nebuchadnezzar and the enemies will strike them with the sword.
They will not spare them.
They will not show pity.
They will not show compassion.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֣ן נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֡ה אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֣ה וְאֶת־ עֲבָדָ֣יו׀ וְאֶת־ הָעָ֡ם וְאֶת־ הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֩ בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את מִן־ הַדֶּ֣בֶר׀ מִן־ הַחֶ֣רֶב וּמִן־ הָרָעָ֗ב בְּיַד֙ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וּבְיַד֙ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְהִכָּ֣ם לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב לֹֽא־ יָח֣וּס עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יַחְמֹ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יְרַחֵֽם׃

passages.text: Furthermore, you are to tell this people that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
The LORD says these words.
I, the LORD, give you a choice.
I place before you two paths.
One path is the way of life.
The other path is the way of death.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י נֹתֵן֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֶת־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמָּֽוֶת׃

passages.text: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who besiege you will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
God warns about the coming danger.
Anyone who stays in this city will die.
They will die by the sword.
They will die by famine.
They will die by plague.
The Chaldeans are surrounding the city.
Anyone who leaves the city and surrenders to the Chaldeans will live.
That person will keep his life.
His life will be like a prize taken in war.
passages.original: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וְהַיּוֹצֵא֩ וְנָפַ֨ל עַל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים עֲלֵיכֶם֙ יִחְיֶה וְהָֽיְתָה־ לּ֥וֹ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ לְשָׁלָֽל׃

passages.text: For I have set My face against this city to bring disaster and not good, declares the LORD. It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, who will destroy it with fire.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD has set His face against this city.
The LORD will bring disaster to this city.
The LORD will not bring good to this city.
The LORD declares this.
The LORD will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon.
The king of Babylon will destroy this city with fire.
passages.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֣מְתִּי פָ֠נַי בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את לְרָעָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה בְּיַד־ מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ תִּנָּתֵ֔ן וּשְׂרָפָ֖הּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: Moreover, tell the house of the king of Judah to hear the word of the LORD.
passages.sermon: The LORD spoke to the house of the king of Judah.\r\nThe LORD commanded them to listen to His word.
passages.original: וּלְבֵית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: O house of David, this is what the LORD says: ‘Administer justice every morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the house of David.
The LORD commands you.
Judge with justice every morning.
Rescue the person who has been robbed.
Take the victim from the hand of the oppressor.
If you do not do this, My anger will come out like fire.
My wrath will burn.
No one will be able to put it out.
This will happen because of their evil actions.
passages.original: בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּ֤ינוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק פֶּן־ תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗י וּבָעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃

passages.text: Behold, I am against you who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau— declares the LORD— you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our dwellings?”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Judah.
The LORD declares His opposition.
He addresses those who live above the valley.
He speaks to those who dwell on the rocky plateau.
These people feel secure in their high place.
They say, “Who can come against us?”
They ask, “Who can enter our dwellings?”
The LORD announces that He is against their pride and false security.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלַ֜יִךְ יֹשֶׁ֧בֶת הָעֵ֛מֶק צ֥וּר הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ מִֽי־ יֵחַ֣ת עָלֵ֔ינוּ וּמִ֥י יָב֖וֹא בִּמְעוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forest that will consume everything around you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will punish you.
The LORD will punish you because of your deeds.
The LORD will start a fire in your forest.
This fire will burn everything around your forest.
passages.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כִּפְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּיַעְרָ֔הּ וְאָכְלָ֖ה כָּל־ סְבִיבֶֽיהָ׃ס
